title: Seek God with All Your Heart and Witness His Miracles in Your Life
text: Before we pray, let's first take a moment to listen to God's word and then we'll pray together. Jeremiah 29:13 says, "You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart. Father in heaven, your word is pure and true. And this promise from Jeremiah burns deep within my soul. You have said that if I seek you with all my heart, I will find you. Not perhaps, not maybe, not if the timing is convenient, but with certainty. You have promised to make yourself known to those who truly search for you. And today, I come before you with a longing that I cannot satisfy on my own. My heart aches to know you more. Not just to know about you, not just to be comforted by you in times of trouble, but to truly walk in your presence, to breathe in your nearness, and to live each moment as one who has found the treasure of life in you. Lord, I confess that too often my seeking has been half-hearted. I have allowed distractions, fears, and even my own pride to dull my pursuit of you. Forgive me for the times when I have sought answers more than I sought the answerer. When I have chased blessings more than I chased the one who blesses. Forgive me when my prayers have been hurried or mechanical. When I have spoken to you without truly opening my heart wide to hear what you would say. Lord, I repent of shallow devotion and ask for a hunger that will not be satisfied until I have found you in deeper ways. You have said that those who hunger and thirst for righteousness will be filled. So here I am, hungry and thirsty. I do not want to remain at the edges of your presence. I want to step fully into the Holy of Holies, into the place where your glory dwells. I want my heart to beat in rhythm with yours. I want to walk with you in such closeness that every word I speak, every thought I think, every action I take flows out of an awareness of your nearness. I want the flame of first love for you to burn so brightly that nothing else compares. Lord, strip away the false gods in my life. anything that has taken a place in my heart that belongs only to you. Pull down the idols of comfort, recognition, control, and self-sufficiency. Show me the places where I have been content with surface level faith and lead me into deeper waters. I do not want to seek you only when I am in need or in trouble. I want to seek you daily, joyfully, eagerly. When the skies are clear and when storms rage, when my heart feels light and when my soul feels burdened. You have invited me to seek you with all my heart. And so I ask, Lord, what does all my heart truly mean? It means no divided loyalties. It means no hidden corners that I keep from you. It means my love, my will, my desires, my priorities all bending toward you. It means that you are not an addition to my life but the center of it. Oh God, help me to love you with all my heart, all my soul, all my mind, and all my strength. Help me to seek you not just with my emotions, but with my choices, not just with my words, but with my obedience. Not just in the sacred moments but in the ordinary ones too. Father, I know that to seek you is to let go of myself. It is to surrender my need to control the path. It is to trust that you are worth finding, worth pursuing, worth giving everything else up for. So I lay down my pride, my fears, my need to be right, my desire to be in control. I lay down my timelines, my expectations, and my conditions. I choose to seek you on your terms, not mine. Because I know that you are wiser than I could ever be. Lord, I remember that seeking is not passive. It is active. It is like a traveler searching for hidden treasure. like a shepherd searching for a lost sheep. Like a woman turning her house upside down to find a missing coin. Seeking means persistence. It means not giving up when you seem silent. It means pressing in even when my flesh feels weak. I ask you to give me the perseverance of Jacob who wrestled with the angel and said, "I will not let you go until you bless me." I want to hold on to you in the night seasons, refusing to loosen my grip until I have touched the depths of your presence. Lord, I am aware that finding you does not mean possessing you like an object, but knowing you in relationship. It means walking with you as Adam walked in the cool of the day. It means recognizing your voice like a sheep knows the voice of its shepherd. It means being attentive to your whispers and willing to obey even before I see the outcome. I want to know the contours of your heart so well that I recognize when you are pleased and when you are grieved. You have said that if I draw near to you, you will draw near to me. And so I take steps toward you right now. I set aside the noise of the world. I still my mind before you. I open the deepest chambers of my heart to you, even the ones I am afraid for others to see. I give you permission to search me and know me, to reveal any offensive way within me, and to lead me in the way everlasting. Father, I seek you not for what you can give me, but for who you are. I seek you because you are the source of life. Because you are beauty and truth and goodness itself. I seek you because my soul was made for you. And it will always be restless until it rests in you. I seek you because without you, I am like a branch cut off from the vine, destined to wither. I seek you because in your presence there is fullness of joy. and at your right hand are pleasures forever more. Teach me to seek you in the scriptures. Not just reading for information, but searching for revelation. Let me see Jesus in every page, every story, every promise, and every command. Teach me to seek you in prayer, not rushing through my requests, but lingering in communion, listening as much as I speak. Teach me to seek you in worship, not for the sake of a song, but for the joy of your presence. Teach me to seek you in service. Not to earn favor, but to reflect your heart to the world. Lord, when life feels heavy, let my first instinct be to run to you, not away from you. When joy overflows, let my praise rise to you like a fragrant offering. When I am uncertain, let me trust in your wisdom more than my own reasoning. When I am wounded, let me find healing in the shadow of your wings. Let me seek you in the valleys as much as I do on the mountaintops. Let me be content in every season, knowing that you are near. I seek you for guidance, Lord, but I also seek you for transformation. I know that when I find you, I cannot remain the same. Your presence changes everything. It refineses. It purifies. It heals. It strengthens. It comforts. It empowers. And so I welcome that change. Even when it is uncomfortable, even when it calls me to let go of things I thought I needed. Make me more like Jesus in thought, word, and deed. Lord, I remember that you are not hiding from me. You are not a distant god playing a game of spiritual hideand seek. You are a father who delights to be found who runs to meet the prodigal on the road home. You reveal yourself to the humble, to the childlike, to those who come in faith. So I strip away my pretenses, my spiritual pride, my self-importance. I come simply as a child, eager to be with my father, trusting that your arms are open wide. Even in the moments when I feel like I cannot sense you, I will keep seeking. Because faith is not based on feelings, but on the truth of your word. And your word says that if I seek you with all my heart, I will find you. That promise is my anchor when my emotions waver. It is the light that guides me through confusion. It is the reason I will not give up. Lord, help me to seek you with expectancy. Let me approach each day with the anticipation that I will encounter you in some way through scripture, through prayer, through nature, through conversations, through quiet moments of reflection. Let me never take your presence for granted, but let me treasure it as the greatest gift. I seek you for myself, but I also intercede for others who are searching. For those who do not yet know you, reveal yourself to them in undeniable ways. For those who have known you but have wandered, draw them back with cords of love. For those who are weary in their seeking renew their strength and remind them of your promises, let my own pursuit of you become a testimony that inspires others to seek you as well. Lord, in the stillness of this moment, I lift my eyes to you. You are my God, my refuge, my shepherd, my king. You are the one I long for, the one who satisfies, the one who holds all things together. You are not far away. You're near to all who call upon you in truth. And so I call upon you now, not as a stranger, but as a beloved child, asking for more of you. I will seek you in the morning before the day's noise begins. I will seek you in the evening when the shadows fall. I will seek you in times of laughter and in times of tears. I will seek you when the path is clear and when it is shrouded in fog. I will seek you when my heart feels strong and when it feels broken. And I will keep seeking until the day when faith becomes sight and I see you face to face. Thank you Lord for the gift of this promise. Thank you that you make yourself findable. Thank you that my seeking is not in vain. Thank you for the countless ways you reveal yourself in creation, in scripture, in the whisper of the spirit, in the person of Jesus Christ. Thank you that even now as I pray, you are here. I love you, Lord, and I want to love you more. I know I cannot even seek you without your spirit drawing me. So I thank you for that drawing. Increase my capacity to love, to hunger, to thirst for you. Let every other desire be secondary to the desire to know you. If this prayer has touched your heart, please type amen as a sign of faith and subscribe to our channel to stay connected as part of the Grace Enclave family. I pray that every blessing in this prayer is now upon you in the name of Jesus. And if you need a special prayer, feel free to let us know in the comment. We would be honored to pray for you. May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you always.
